status: RESEARCH ONLY. Declared before any residual, coherence or contradiction number was computed. Nothing here is served.
question: Owner 2026-11-11: combine the team, props and Pro models; in matches with a higher chance of many goals, is SoT (and SoT 2+ / anytime scorer) more likely than the props model alone says?

data.development_months: 2025-01-01..2026-03-31 (calendar months). The team model's holdout (2026-04-01..2026-11-08) and the props holdout/spent window (2026-09-01..) are never scored.
data.team_model: phase2-retrain-1.0 champion_recipe, stage walk_forward only, Standard run_20261110T203611Z + New-Format run_20261110T203319Z (frame 58f10476). p_over15, p_over25, p_over35, p_btts. A match scored by two folds keeps the earlier fold.
data.props_model: the served recipe player_model.props_harness.HGBNaNNative (hgb_nan_native, promoted from run 42855107089), feature rule all_prior_verified, 128 features (config.PLAYER_FEATURE_COLS), refitted at the first day of every development month on all eligible rows dated before it (fit/calibration split by props_harness.fit_window). Out-of-sample for every scored month. This is the served RECIPE, not the served pickle: the served pickle was fitted through 2026-08-31 and is in-sample on development dates.
data.pro_model: Pro wowzaV9-Pro data-truth-100 9cdfa207 src/specials/study.py SPC-1 unchanged: per league Dixon-Coles refitted monthly on earlier matches of v9's repaired history (exported from this v9 commit); lam_home, lam_away, p_ge6, cand_ge6 (0.9 quantile of the league's earlier-month predictions).
data.pro_1x2: not used: the Pro 1X2 model's per-match walk-forward predictions are not stored; the Dixon-Coles lambdas carry the side strengths.
data.outcomes: props labels from the harness frame (target_sot, target_sot2, target_goals, verified counts); team O2.5 label from the team frame.
data.join: v9 team names -> API-Football names by a per-league crosswalk learned from exact normalised names and score-proven same-date fixtures (>= 3 votes, >= 90% share, one-to-one); fixtures joined on league + date (+-1 day when unique); a known score that disagrees drops the fixture.
data.prices: props prices exist only from 2026-10-14, all inside spent windows or forward. No price is read for any test; price files are only COUNTED for the forward inventory.

leak_rules: every probability is out of sample for its date (fitted strictly before the month)
every cutoff (tercile, quintile, 6+ flag) is a quantile of the SAME league's earlier months only

starters (started == 1) are used for fixture-level props aggregates: the starting XI is public before kickoff; substitutes are used only in per-player Q1 rows, as the served props population (players who play) already is

q1_conditioning.unit: player x fixture x market, markets sot, sot2, goals; residual = y - p_props

conditioners.team_p_over25: team model P(Over 2.5) of the fixture
conditioners.dc_lam_side: Pro Dixon-Coles expected goals of the player's own team

q1_conditioning.groups: top tercile (>= league earlier-month 2/3 quantile of the fixture-level conditioner, min 200 earlier fixtures) vs bottom tercile (<= 1/3 quantile); middle excluded
q1_conditioning.effect: mean residual top - mean residual bottom, per league x market x conditioner
q1_conditioning.test: two-sided (a negative effect is a finding too)
q1_conditioning.read_minimum: 30 fixtures in each group; thinner cells enter the Holm family with p = 1
context_only: logistic slope logit(y) ~ offset(logit p_props) + b z(conditioner), fixture-clustered SE

q2_coherence.team_high: p_over25 >= league earlier-month 2/3 quantile; team_low: <= 1/3 quantile
q2_coherence.props_volume: V = mean p_sot over the fixture's recorded starters (both sides), fixture needs >= 18 recorded starters
q2_coherence.props_high: V >= league earlier-month 2/3 quantile of V (min 100 earlier fixtures); props_low: <= 1/3 quantile
q2_coherence.props_tip: a starter whose p_props >= the league earlier-month 0.8 quantile of starters' p_props for that market (min 200 earlier rows)

tests.T2a_team_tips_props_agree: fixtures with team_high: residual (y_over25 - p_over25), props_high minus props_low; one-sided effect > 0
tests.T2b_props_tips_team_agree: props tips (sot, sot2, goals): residual (y - p_props), team_high minus team_low; one-sided
tests.T2c_team_tips_dc_flag: fixtures with team_high: residual (y_over25 - p_over25), dc_flag 1 minus 0; one-sided
tests.T2d_props_tips_dc_flag: props tips (sot, sot2, goals): residual, dc_flag 1 minus 0; one-sided

holm_family: ONE family: every per-league Q1 and Q2 cell searched, readable or not (unreadable cells enter with p = 1). Pooled and logistic-slope rows are context and are not in the family.
signal_rule: a per-league cell is a DEVELOPMENT SIGNAL only when readable and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. No cell can be PROVEN on development data: PROVEN needs >= 150 priced bets with CI > 0 after Holm, and no development row has a price. A signal only earns a forward paper protocol.

q3_contradictions.scores: per league (descriptive, in-sample standardisation): z_team = z(implied Poisson total from team p_over15/25/35), z_dc = z(dc_lam_total), z_props = z(V)
q3_contradictions.diagnostics: league, month, team, team history depth (DC n_train), recorded starters, props feature NaN share, which model the realised total goals sided with
q3_contradictions.use: a bug-finder list, never a tip rule
